The following works are '''not''' Bob Dylan works:

Not to be confused with another song also titled "Prisoner of Love", which has not been confirmed, but was supposed to have been written and recorded in 1987 as a collaboration between Dylan and Bono.

-------

Born in Bay City, Michigan, USA, as Madonna Louise Ciccone, Madonna had the extra middle name Veronica added in childhood as confirmation of her family's Catholicism.
Her music career took off in the early 1980's under the performance name [http://musicbrainz.org/artist/79239441-bfd5-4981-a70c-55c3f15c1287.html|Madonna].

It is believed her legal name has changed due to marriage to first Sean Penn, and then Guy Ritchie.

name: Radiohead
annotation:
Formed in Oxford, UK. Originally performed as '''[http://musicbrainz.org/artist/c74f4726-2671-4011-81b6-f70da905c05a.html|On a Friday]''' until 1991.

Currently, Radiohead track names on bootlegs are standardized with the name on the album, except for tracks of Hail to the Thief due to the subtitles. There is only one album that uses their full names, which is Hail to the Thief. (The Gloaming.)

Standardized track names: (Nice Dream); Street Spirit (Fade Out); Exit Music (for a Film); Pearly*; The National Anthem; You and Whose Army?; Dollars and Cents; 2 + 2 = 5; Sit Down, Stand Up; A Punchup at a Wedding.

Current band members: [http://musicbrainz.org/artist/1a60d6dd-9d3e-40fc-a66d-3184f9ee0d61.html|Eddie Vedder] (vocals), [http://musicbrainz.org/artist/ca7e6e03-4973-45ef-8833-98774a2d4138.html|Stone Gossard] (guitar), [http://musicbrainz.org/artist/16cb4a74-225a-4262-a885-628083f12460.html|Mike McCready] (guitar), [http://musicbrainz.org/artist/2781b946-104c-47d3-a573-2eade82f68cd.html|Jeff Ament] (bass guitar) and [http://musicbrainz.org/artist/07e93890-46a1-4ebd-9a70-3988a2135d87.html|Matt Cameron] (drums).

All bootlegs of concerts should be named --> "date: venue, city, state, country". See the album list below for examples. On the official bootlegs covers there is a number, that number should be added at the end of the title like: "date: venue, city, state, country (#<number>)" with '<number>' replaced by the correct number.

Correct track names that are often misspelled: "Better Man"; "Hail, Hail"; "Rearviewmirror"; "Elderly Woman Behind the Counter in a Small Town"; "1/2 Full";

Side projects: [http://musicbrainz.org/artist/e9571c17-817f-4d34-ae3f-0c7a96f822c1.html|Temple of the Dog], [http://musicbrainz.org/artist/edbaa513-b8d3-4e8f-b81f-ef640b8ad128.html|Brad], [http://musicbrainz.org/artist/bfd085b8-0bbf-46b3-8ab9-193bca5c85e7.html|Mad Season], [http://musicbrainz.org/artist/5cf17a36-08e6-4054-bf00-8868438d33d3.html|Three Fish], [http://musicbrainz.org/artist/e3304cba-b983-4cdf-a083-37f54f27cc1d.html|Wellwater Conspiracy] and [http://musicbrainz.org/artist/f40ce3f1-9dcf-41c9-89ca-3bf25bd629e3.html|The Rockfords].

name: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart
annotation:
'''Additional Notes:'''
Born as: Joannes Chrisostomos Wolfgang Gottlieb Mozart
Baptized as: Joannes Chrysostomus Wolfgangus Theophilus Mozart

Mozart himself preferred the Italian-ized and French-ified versions of Gottlieb: Amadeo, Amadè and Amadé

Mozart actually only ever used the name as "Amadeus" three times among his letters and compositions, among at least 77 different variations of his name used throughout his lifetime.


Help us organize Philips' Complete Mozart Edition by finding any missing or new albums you add/import to the [http://wiki.musicbrainz.org/Series/MozartCompletePhilips|Series/Mozart Complete Philips] wiki page.

You may want to consult [http://wiki.musicbrainz.org/CSGStandard/Mozart|the CSG worklist] for guidance.
Punk rock trio formed in Rodeo, California in 1987 by Billie Joe Armstrong (vocals, guitar) and Mike Dirnt (bass). Tré Cool joined on drums in 1990. Released "39/Smooth" (1990) and "Dookie" (1994).

annotation:
Swedish group. Most of the songs were written by Benny Andersson and Björn Ulvaeus, and sometimes Stig Anderson.

There have been 7 known masters of the original studio recordings:
    1. Original releases (1974–1981)
    2. CD releases (1982–1992)
    3. ABBA Gold and Thank You for the Music Box Set (1992–1994), remastered by Michael B. Tretow
    4. Remastered releases (1997), remastered by Jon Astley and Tim Young.
    5. Remastered releases (2001), when Jon Astley revisited his earlier remasters, and fixed some errors.
    6. Remastered releases (2005), made by Henrik Jonsson. Featured on “The Complete Studio Recordings” and “The Albums” box sets.
    7. Remastered releases (2005–), feature on the Deluxe albums. Some of these albums use the same remasters as the previous two box sets, some are completely new remasters (Voulez-vous, Super Trouper, The Visitors, ABBA).

Releases under "Bob Marley & The Wailers" belong here, '''no matter the band lineup'''.  

Releases under "The Wailing Wailers", "The Wailers", or "Marley, Tosh, Livingston & Associates" belong under [http://musicbrainz.org/artist/c9e99d40-4a2c-4ca7-ac5b-e842264ee271.html|"The Wailing Wailers"], '''unless''' the track or release was produced by Lee "Scratch" Perry, in which case it ought to be listed here, not there.

Releases by The Wailers Band after Bob Marley's death belong under [http://musicbrainz.org/artist/1e46801d-c27b-4f07-a50d-51597a26df60.html|"The Wailers Band"].

This group spans two different time periods:
December 1970 - 1971 and 1974 - May 11, 1981

name: Carlo Zerulo Dj
annotation:
Carlo Zerulo Dj, all’anagrafe Carlo Zerulo, sipontino doc, attualmente uno dei disc jockey pugliesi più seguiti,  nasce artisticamente nel 2004-2005 ed il suo cammino verso la musica prende le mosse sin da bambino. In consolle e nelle sue produzioni, Zerulo si fa apprezzare per il suo mix fatto di suoni diversi che spaziano dall’Electronic Dance Music, all’Electro House, Progressive House e Deep House.

Nazionalità: Italiana

Nascita: Manfredonia (Fg)

Genere: Elettronic Dance Music, Electro house, Progressive house , Deep house
